'''Far Dostany''' was a location<ref name="Insider144">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref> in the [[Far Dostany system/Legends|Far Dostany system]], a part of the [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="NewTerritories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At one point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HondoDate">{{HondoOhnakaScoreDate}}</ref> a quartet of [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] from Far Dostany&mdash;whose [[Music/Legends|musical]] repertoire included [[Waltz/Legends|waltzes]] and [[minuet]]s but who could also play [[scrak]] and [[Smazzo/Legends|smazzo]]&mdash;performed aboard the [[C-One liner|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' on its cruise along<ref name="Insider144" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Far Dostany was mentioned in [[Jason Fry]]'s short story "[[Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 144|144th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider144" /> on [[September 3]], [[2013]].<ref name="Insider144Date">[[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]]</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Far Dostany [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Far Dostany itself, in grid square M-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
